title: RLE Iterator
description: Design an iterator that iterates through a run-length encoded sequence.

steps.note: Initialize iterator with encoding [3, 8, 2, 5]. Requesting next(2).
Check if requested n=2 is less than or equal to current count 3.
Return the value at index + 1, which is 8.
Requesting next(2) again. Index is 0, count is 1.
n (2) > encoding[0] (1). Subtract count from n: 2 - 1 = 1.
Move to next run at index 2.
Check n=1 against count 2. 1 <= 2 is true.
Return value at index 3, which is 5.
